system.description: A clear, ringing antler shard from a thin place. Once per day, when you would become Charmed or Frightened, you do not. Expendable d20.
system.lastRite: ◈◈ Break it: you and up to four allies within 10' step through a thin place and come out anywhere you have been within a day's walk.
system.drawback: The fey court notices its loss: something follows you, and the Dark Master decides what.
